_comment: F-16A Block 10/15 Level-2 inputs. Read by F16GeomL2 (.geometry) and F16AeroL2 (.aerodynamics). Geometry = Brandt-F16-A.xls Main-tab spec; aerodynamics = genuine aero spec (ALL geometry injected from the geom object, none stored here).

geometry._src: Brandt-F16-A.xls Main tab (wing B18:B24, pitch_ctrl C18:C24, vert_tail H18:H24, fuselage B32/C32/D32, engine Engn(s)); HT/VT tc_root/tc_tip = T.O. 1F-16A-1 Sec. I biconvex splits.

aerodynamics._src: Cfe = Raymer 6th Table 12.3 (AF fighter, 0.0035) for Eq. 12.23 CD0. e_method='official' = Raymer Eq. 12.48/12.49. airfoil = NACA 64A204 (T.O. 1F-16A-1 Fig. 1-2).

airfoil.name: NACA 64A204
airfoil._TODO_alpha_L0_deg: alpha_L0=-1.01 unverified vs a primary NACA 64A204 source (thin-airfoil ~ -1.4 to -1.9); remove this key when pinned. Guarded by TestAeroL2.testTODO_AlphaL0Unverified.
airfoil._TODO_cl_max_2D: cl_max_2D=1.20 (Abbott & von Doenhoff) conflicts with NTRS-19870017427's 1.0; remove when reconciled. Guarded by TestAeroL2.testTODO_ClMax2DUnverified.
airfoil._TODO_cl_alpha_per_deg: cl_alpha=0.105/deg is an internet-band midpoint, not primary-sourced; remove when pinned. Guarded by TestAeroL2.testTODO_ClAlpha2DUnverified.

propulsion._src: Brandt-F16-A.xls Engn(s) tab (T_AB_SLS, T_mil_SLS), Main!C29 (dry/mil), Main!D29 (AB), Miss!C25 = Main!C25 (install factor); T.O. 1F-16A-1 Sec. I; Mattingly AED 2nd ed. (TSFC Eq. 3.55a/b, T_t4 Table C.4). Per examples/F16A/F16PropL2.md + docs/propulsion_parameter_usage.md Part A/B, these are the engine-spec inputs F16PropL2 reads; all lapse/TSFC/TR OUTPUTS are DERIVED and are not stored here.
propulsion._thrust_source: SLS thrusts, lbf. T_SL / T_SL_wet = AB (max) = Brandt Engn!T_AB_SLS = Main!D29 = 23770; T_SL_mil = military (dry) = Brandt Engn!T_mil_SLS = Main!C29 = 15000; T.O. 1F-16A-1 Sec. I.
propulsion._C_note: The Mattingly TSFC coefficients (C1_mil/C2_mil/C1_AB/C2_AB = 0.90/0.30/1.60/0.27, Eq. 3.55a/b) are NOT stored here. Per user decision 2026-07-24 they are engine-class Constants selected by engine_type inside the PropL2 toolbox (mirroring PropL1's engine_type-keyed lapse/TSFC tables) -- this JSON supplies only engine_type, which selects the coefficient set. Verified-agreement provenance in todo.md 2026-07-24 entry 5.
propulsion._T_t4_max_source: Burner-exit total temperature, deg F. Mattingly AED 2nd ed. Table C.4 (F100-PW-100).
propulsion._T_t4_max_note: Feeds the throttle-ratio input (TR = T_t4_max / T_t4_SLS, Mattingly Eq. D.6). T_t4_SLS is unknown, so the DERIVED TR defaults to 1.0 (independently corroborated by Brandt Engn(s)!S1). TR is derived and is NOT stored in this input block.
propulsion._TSFC_install_factor_source: Brandt Miss!C25 = Main!C25 (readme_mission.md Engine Model; also stored in GroundTruth/f16a_geometry.json engine.TSFC_install_factor).
propulsion._TSFC_install_factor_note: The framework wires installed = uninstalled x 1.08 onto the Mattingly (uninstalled) TSFC. The stored Brandt SLS TSFCs 0.70 (mil) / 2.20 (AB) are ALREADY installed (they include the 1.08 factor) -- do not double-apply (todo.md 2026-07-24 entry 4).
propulsion._engine_type_note: Engine-class identifier (F100-PW-200 class). Selects the Mattingly TSFC coefficient set (C1/C2 mil+AB, Eq. 3.55a/b) from the PropL2 toolbox's engine_type-keyed table (user decision 2026-07-24, decision b). The thrust lapse (Mattingly Eq. 2.54a/b) uses the analytical model directly.
propulsion._engine_model_note: Descriptor: F-16A Block 10/15 powerplant (F100-PW-200 class), per examples/F16A/F16PropL1.md. Recorded for provenance; not read numerically. Note T_t4_max_F traces to Mattingly Table C.4's F100-PW-100 entry, the closest tabulated variant.
